learning: Iterations 9 and 10 each changed one variable from iteration 8 and scored lower: a 0.016 m sensor footprint added slalom off-track endings (16/20), and a 0.044 m wheel gave more line-loss pressure without a clear completion gain. Iteration 8's controller (kd 0.65) kept s-bend oscillation at 0.34, so no kd change is needed for this geometry. The unseen track is the main uncertainty. Its shape may need more turn authority or more damping than the development tracks show, and this package has no evidence for either.
notes: Exact iteration 8 package: the Builder's geometry matches iteration 8 field for field, and the controller is iteration 8's unchanged. Kept because it is the only design with 60/60 completions and the best score. The full measurement set is requested so the final result can be compared with iteration 8.
rationale: This is the final iteration, and the Builder's proposal is the iteration 8 geometry exactly: body 0.10 x 0.08 m, mass 0.40 kg, seven sensors at y=0.08 m spanning x=-0.03 to +0.03 m, sensor_size 0.012 m, wheel_radius 0.040 m, wheel_track 0.105 m. Iteration 8 is the only design with 60/60 completions and the best score (939.3), and its controller is the one that produced it. The Builder asked me to check kd against this geometry. The evidence does not justify changing it: kd 0.65 gave s-bend steering_oscillation of 0.34 with all 60 development trials finished and slalom max_error of 0.023. Iteration 9 (sensor_size 0.016 m) and iteration 10 (wheel_radius 0.044 m) both lowered results, so neither change is carried over. I therefore keep kp 3.8, ki 0.15 (for the fixed left/right motor mismatch), kd 0.65, base_speed 1.4, last_direction line loss, and sensor weights x/0.015 (-2 to +2, positive = left). The signal remains sign-correct, and no untested controller change is added on an unseen track. Expected result, not claimed: about the iteration 8 level on the development tracks, with completions held at 60/60.
